name: Admin Diagnostic Document Preview
description: From the Documentos tab of the diagnostic edit page, admin clicks the eye icon next to an attachment. A modal opens previewing the file inline — PDF (rendered in iframe) or image (via tag), gated by frontend/utils/filePreview.js (canPreviewFile). Non-previewable files keep only the existing download action. Replaces the previous inline template-expand behavior on DiagnosticDocumentsTab.
knownGaps: Eye-icon preview modal replaced inline template-expand in DiagnosticDocumentsTab.vue on 2026-04-26 (commit 9877df24). Component-level unit test exists (DiagnosticDocumentsTab.spec.js); E2E spec pending.
